name: Kokushikan Kikka
source:
"I-It's your fault... for throwing my heart into disarray like this..."

Energetic and friendly. Emotional and gets tensed over the smallest things. Cannot control her emotions. Overreacts to everything and is noisy.

[From [url=https://x.com/SpikeChunsoft_e/status/1935049813252354096]official Twitter[/url]]

[spoiler]She and her "sisters," [url=/c153059]Mii[/url] and [url=/c153058]Yua[/url], are alternate personas and disguises for [url=/c153056]Honoka Kokushikan[/url].[/spoiler]
